title: How to Make a Quarto Blog
text:
Creating a Quarto blog
A Quarto blog can be created using Visual Studio Code.
First, open the Command Palette:
Ctrl + Shift + P
Then select:
Quarto: Create Project
Choose Blog Project, select a location, and give the project a name.

title: How to Make a Quarto Blog
text:
Exploring the blog
A Quarto blog contains several files and folders.
The posts folder contains the individual blog posts. The index.qmd file controls the main page of the blog.

title: How to Make a Quarto Blog
text:
Previewing the blog
Quarto can render the blog into HTML. The rendered blog can then be viewed in a web browser.

title: How to Make a Quarto Blog
text:
What I learned
Creating this blog helped me learn how Quarto projects are structured and how Markdown can be used to create web content.
